title: 2 Corinthians
author: Paul the apostle.
historicalSetting: Paul defends Gospel ministry through weakness, reconciliation, generosity, and apostolic suffering.
keyVerse: 2 Corinthians 5:21 — "For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf."
christFocus: Second Corinthians points to Christ as the crucified and risen Lord whose grace is displayed through weakness and whose reconciliation forms Gospel ministry.
